name: Animation Studios
job_description:
Animation Studios -- end-to-end animation video production.

Autonomous in creating end-to-end animation videos for our internal team, with minimal feedback from our animators, available on a daily basis for revisions + feedback. Needs to deliver our level of quality animation-wise. Their job is to deliver scenes daily to our team that we have given them.

This is a Visual Role -- needs portfolio/reel review (not just resume/experience).

Core qualities to look for: Professional, proven background, very flexible.

Adjacent/similar backgrounds that could do the job well (not an exact title match, but could do the job well): Animation Studio, Motion Design Agency, Launch Agency, SaaS Explainer Video Agency, 2D animation agency.

Scoring priorities from the internal criteria scorecard (5 = most important):
- Craft/output quality (5): Portfolio, work samples, or past output quality relative to the role
- Exact experience (5): Background corresponds and maps out exactly what we are looking for
- Relevant experience (3): Similar skillset, possibly a different niche
- Communication (2.5): Clear, concise, no red flags in how they present themselves/their work, client-facing
- Role/culture fit (1): Pace, ownership style, and working style match how this team operates

Work-specific red flags that directly result in bad quality of work:
- Not flexible
- No-shows meetings, doesn't seem to care about the business
- Late on deadlines
- Too picky (yellow flag -- lower severity than the others)
